The SanDisk 64GB Extreme PRO microSD is a top-of-the-line memory card designed for use in smartphones, tablets, action cameras, and other devices that require high-speed and reliable storage. With read and write speeds of up to 200MB/s and 90MB/s, respectively, this card is perfect for capturing and transferring large files quickly and efficiently.

One of the standout features of the SanDisk 64GB Extreme PRO microSD is its blazing-fast transfer speeds. With read speeds of up to 200MB/s, you can transfer even the largest files in seconds, making it an ideal choice for professionals who need to work quickly and efficiently.
Additionally, the card has write speeds of up to 90MB/s, which makes it perfect for capturing high-resolution photos and videos.
Another great feature of the SanDisk 64GB Extreme PRO microSD is its durability.
The card is shockproof, temperature-proof, waterproof, and X-ray-proof, which means that it can withstand extreme conditions and keep your data safe.
This makes it an excellent choice for use in outdoor environments or in situations where your equipment might be subject to rough handling.
Overall, the SanDisk 64GB Extreme PRO microSD is a high-performance memory card that offers lightning-fast transfer speeds, ample storage space, and excellent durability.
Whether you’re a professional photographer or videographer or just looking for a reliable memory card for your smartphone or tablet, this card is an excellent choice that is sure to meet your needs.
